rootGroups.name: Product, Catalog, and Content Data
rootGroups.description: Catalogs, listings, inventory, content, media, products, and merchandising data exposed through customer or operator experiences.

subGroups.name: Core Records
subGroups.description: Durable domain entities and business objects.

assets.name: Classified / Listing
assets.description: Published or draft real estate marketplace offer with lifecycle, visibility, property facts, pricing, media references, seller or intermediary ownership, and lead-routing state.
assets.accessScope: classified search, detail pages, intermediary portfolios, owner classifieds management, imports, exports, recommendations, and analytics
assets.businessMeaning: Primary supply object that seekers discover and intermediaries or owners manage across the real estate marketplace.

interfaces.name: classified api
interfaces.description: Create, update, publish, retrieve, and manage real estate classifieds.

interfaces.name: classified-changed
interfaces.description: Event emitted when classified lifecycle, visibility, pricing, or content changes.

governance.retention: active classified lifecycle plus legal and audit window
governance.sharingPolicy: public fields can be published; draft, owner, and performance data remain internal and role-controlled

assets.name: Property Reference
assets.description: Normalized basic data about a property referenced by classifieds, including address or location reference, property type, size, room counts, building facts, geospatial keys, and valuation context.
assets.accessScope: classified creation, deduplication, georeferencing, valuation, location insights, search filters, and analytics
assets.businessMeaning: Connects multiple classifieds, valuations, and location signals to the same underlying property without treating every listing as a separate property.

interfaces.name: property-reference api
interfaces.description: Resolve, retrieve, and enrich property reference records used by classifieds and valuation workflows.

governance.retention: active property reference plus source evidence audit window
governance.sharingPolicy: internal and approved property, valuation, search, and classifieds workflows only

subGroups.name: Documents and Evidence
subGroups.description: Documents, media, knowledge, files, and evidence packages.

assets.name: Listing Media
assets.description: Photos, floor plans, videos, virtual-tour references, captions, ordering, moderation state, rights metadata, and transformation references attached to classifieds.
assets.accessScope: classified creation, detail pages, media management, moderation, search presentation, exports, and analytics
assets.businessMeaning: Carries the visual evidence and presentation assets that make a classified inspectable and trustworthy.

interfaces.name: listing-media api
interfaces.description: Upload, retrieve, order, moderate, transform, and attach listing media to classifieds.

interfaces.name: listing-media-changed
interfaces.description: Event emitted when listing media is uploaded, transformed, moderated, reordered, or removed.

governance.retention: active classified lifecycle plus media rights and audit window
governance.sharingPolicy: published media can be displayed publicly; drafts, moderation state, and rights metadata remain role-controlled
